newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-RAIN WASHES OUT NATAL VS W.P. MATCH.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RAIN WASHES OUT NATAL VS W.P. MATCH.

text.p: Rain washed out any chance of victory for either side in the Supersport Series cricket match between new champions Natal and their predecessors Western Province at Newlands on Monday.

Needing to make 297 for victory on the final day of the domestic first class season, Natal were 55 for one at lunch when torrential rain washed out the rest of the day's play. At that point Natal still needed 242 runs from a minimum of 73 overs for victory.
In the play that was possible Western Province added seven runs to their overnight 215 for nine before skipper John Commins was the last man out for 14.
Natal began their run chase after losing Errol Stewart for nine with the score on 15.
But Andrew Hudson -- dropped from the South African test team on Monday -- had made an undefeated 35 by lunch with Neil Johnson on eight not out.
Bowling: Gilder 16-5-48-1, Johnson 10-1-38-2, Crookes 25-6-72-3, Storey 5.5-2-7-2, Symcox 10-3-28-1, Benkenstein 7-1-24-1.
